entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: An adventure world of wild lands, expeditions and dangerous wilderness where mages draw mana through bonds with discovered lands.

entities.name: Turntimber Grove
entities.description: A green-mana site on Zendikar that mages discover and bond with.

entities.name: Zektar Shrine
entities.description: An elemental-infested shrine high in the Shatterskull Mountains, a goal of expeditions.

entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: A rare, powerful site hidden in the center of the Ora Ondar forest.

entities.name: Ora Ondar
entities.description: A forest on Zendikar hiding the Khalni Heart.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A region of Zendikar through which baloths roam.

entities.name: Roil Elemental
entities.description: A being made from the vengeful rage of Zendikar, the force that changes the terrain faster than explorers can conquer it.

entities.name: Territorial Baloth
entities.description: A wild beast that claims any new territory it finds as its own.

entities.name: Hedron Crab
entities.description: A crab that decorates its shell with magic-warping hedrons gathered on the coast.

entities.name: Bloodghast
entities.description: The furious spirit of a fallen vampire, clinging to memories of the marshes of Guul Draz.

entities.name: Emeria Angel
entities.description: An angel whose low-worn halo signifies a strange debt to a forgotten force in Zendikar's past.

entities.name: Surrakar
entities.description: Cultureless, almost wholly feral creatures of bestial intelligence, humanoid only in shape.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A region of fetid marshes on Zendikar.

events.summary: Zendikar's mages and adventurers set out on wilderness expeditions seeking the magical moment of discovery.
events.quote: they're looking to experience that crackling, magical, life-changing moment of discovery.

events.summary: Territorial Baloth discovering a new land grows mean and readies to fight to claim the territory.
events.quote: When one of your Baloths discovers a new land, it gets all mean and gnashy and immediately prepares itself for the battle to claim that territory as its own.

relations.quote: But in Zendikar , it's not just the established mana bond that's important

relations.note: Shrine lies high in the mountains.
relations.quote: the expedition to the elemental-infested Zektar Shrine high in the black-stone Shatterskull Mountains

relations.note: Clings to memories of the marshes of Guul Draz.
relations.quote: Bloodghast is the furious spirit of a fallen vampire, clinging to life by clinging to its memories of the fetid marshes of Guul Draz.
